name: application-rating-input-emoji
title: Rating Input Emoji
description: Emoji-based satisfaction scale input components for collecting quick, expressive feedback in web applications.
useWhen: Emoji-based satisfaction scale input components for collecting quick, expressive feedback in web applications.
avoidWhen: Avoid rating input emoji when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Rating Input Emoji uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
